falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom featured a 12% drawdown with recovery taking 3 weeks; a new all-time high this quickly would break the structural similarity and suggest a shallow correction rather than a durable bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies elevated volatility and stress; sustained VIX compression below 14 would indicate fear has fully evaporated, contradicting the bottoming process which requires volatility persistence to mark capitulation and true bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below its 50-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a flight-to-quality recession panic rather than a growth-scare bottom; the August 2024 bottom occurred with yields stable/rising as growth concerns were localized, so a bond rally with weak equities would invalidate the pattern match and suggest a fundamentally different macro regime

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
